chunks: Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated from Dāwūd ibn al-Nuʿmān, from al-Fuḍayl, the mawlā of Abī ʿAbd Allāh, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله had four of the great angels witness his bequest to ʿAlī عليه السلام: Jabrāʾīl, Mīkāʾīl, Isrāfīl, and another whose name I did not retain.

key_terms.إِسْرَافِيلَ: Isrāfīl, one of the named archangels
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةِ: the angels who served as witnesses
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلَ: Jibrīl, one of the named archangels
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the designated recipient of the bequest
key_terms.مِيكَائِيلَ: Mīkāʾīl, one of the named archangels

ai.seo_question: Which angels witnessed the Prophet’s bequest to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله made great angels witnesses to his bequest to ʿAlī عليه السلام. It highlights the gravity and sacred nature of the وصية, and points to the elevated rank of Imamate and divinely sanctioned succession in Shia tradition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5563 - Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman narrated from Dawud ibn Al-Nu'man from Al-Fudayl, the servant of Abu Abdullah (as), from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

"The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, had four of the great angels witness his will to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), peace be upon him: Jibril, Mika'il, Israfil, and another whose name I do not remember."
